purpose: Known visual heuristics retained in legacy case-study demos. These are reported by validate:all and must not hide failures.

rules.side-stripe-border: artmuse-ios intentionally uses a reference-matching side accent.
rules.over-rounded-ui: Existing case-study visuals retain their original rounded treatment; new production demos should avoid adding more.
rules.tiny-fonts: Some reference-matching labels are intentionally dense; interactive text must still be manually checked at target viewport sizes.
rules.many-fixed-small-widths: Reference-matching mobile controls retain fixed geometry; translated labels require manual overflow review.
rules.shadow-heavy: smart-home-ui-v2 retains layered device surfaces from its reference treatment.
rules.low-contrast: Legacy reference matching retains a small number of borderline text colors; new production screens must meet WCAG contrast targets.
rules.small-touch-target: Several legacy case-study controls preserve reference geometry below 44px; new interactive controls must use at least 44px hit areas.
rules.off-center-icon: Legacy icon alignment is retained for visual matching and remains visible in browser audit output.
rules.dense-micro-text: Legacy media controls retain compact timeline labels; new card UI must avoid text below readable sizes.
